mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within a month signals a loosening of monetary policy, leading to increased liquidity in the market and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within 2 months signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals strong consumer demand and labor market tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals supply-side inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% in the same month.
